stem: After comparing several DR strategies against a stated requirement of losing no more than a few seconds of data, TWO strategies remain candidates before cost is considered. Which TWO are they? (Select TWO.)

choices.text: An Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment within a single Region.

rationale: Warm standby's RPO is measured in seconds, which meets the few-seconds data-loss requirement. Multi-site active/active has a near-zero RPO, which also meets the requirement, making it the other remaining candidate before cost narrows the choice. Backup and restore has an RPO measured in hours, far exceeding a few-seconds data-loss tolerance. Pilot light has an RPO measured in minutes, which still exceeds a requirement of a few seconds. A Multi-AZ RDS deployment is a single-Region high-availability feature, not a cross-Region DR strategy, so it does not belong among the DR strategy candidates at all.
